fact: The World Bank implementation status report of 29 October 2025 says 100 entities were using Fayda services to verify clients at 30 September 2025, with over 32.3 million successful authentications and Fayda mandatory for new bank accounts, new TINs, notary and property transactions, SIM registration and national exam enrolment.
title: Ethiopia Digital ID for Inclusion and Services Project, Implementation Status & Results Report
